WITH cust AS (

         julianday(MAX(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) - julianday(MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp)) AS span_days
  FROM customers c

  JOIN order_payments p ON p.order_id = o.order_id

WITH artist_sales AS (
  SELECT ar.ArtistId AS ArtistId, ar.Name AS Name, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS total_sales
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN artists ar ON ar.ArtistId = a.ArtistId
  GROUP BY ar.ArtistId, ar.Name
),
top_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales DESC, Name ASC LIMIT 1
),
bottom_artist AS (
  SELECT ArtistId FROM artist_sales ORDER BY total_sales ASC, Name ASC LIMIT 1
),
spend AS (
  SELECT i.CustomerId AS CustomerId, a.ArtistId AS ArtistId, SUM(ii.UnitPrice * ii.Quantity) AS spent
  FROM invoice_items ii
  JOIN tracks t ON t.TrackId = ii.TrackId
  JOIN albums a ON a.AlbumId = t.AlbumId
  JOIN invoices i ON i.InvoiceId = ii.InvoiceId
  WHERE a.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist)
     OR a.ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist)
  GROUP BY i.CustomerId, a.ArtistId
)
SELECT ABS(
  (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM spend WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM top_artist))
  -
  (SELECT AVG(spent) FROM spend WHERE ArtistId IN (SELECT ArtistId FROM bottom_artist))
) AS difference_of_average_spending

WITH monthly_balance AS (
  SELECT customer_id,
         CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER) AS month_num,
         SUM(CASE WHEN txn_type = 'deposit' THEN txn_amount
                  WHEN txn_type = 'withdrawal' THEN -txn_amount
                  ELSE 0 END) AS month_end_balance
  FROM customer_transactions
  WHERE strftime('%Y', txn_date) = '2020'
    AND txn_type IN ('deposit', 'withdrawal')
  GROUP BY customer_id, CAST(strftime('%m', txn_date) AS INTEGER)
),
month_stats AS (
  SELECT month_num,
         SUM(CASE WHEN month_end_balance > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS positive_customers,
         AVG(CAST(month_end_balance AS REAL)) AS avg_month_end_balance
  FROM monthly_balance
  GROUP BY month_num
),
hi AS (
  SELECT month_num, avg_month_end_balance
  FROM month_stats
  ORDER BY positive_customers DESC, month_num ASC
  LIMIT 1
),
lo AS (
  SELECT month_num, avg_month_end_balance
  FROM month_stats
  ORDER BY positive_customers ASC, month_num DESC
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT hi.month_num AS month_with_most_positive_customers,

       lo.avg_month_end_balance AS avg_balance_fewest_positive_month,

         CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         SUM(subtotal) AS total_sales
  FROM salesorderheader
  WHERE salespersonid IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY salespersonid, CAST(strftime('%Y', orderdate) AS INTEGER)
),
quota AS (
  SELECT BusinessEntityID AS sp_id,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER) AS yr,
         SUM(SalesQuota) AS total_quota
  FROM SalesPersonQuotaHistory
  GROUP BY BusinessEntityID, CAST(strftime('%Y', QuotaDate) AS INTEGER)
),
keys AS (
  SELECT sp_id, yr FROM sales
  UNION
  SELECT sp_id, yr FROM quota
)
SELECT k.sp_id AS salespersonid,
       k.yr AS year,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) AS total_sales,
       COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0) AS total_sales_quota,
       COALESCE(s.total_sales, 0) - COALESCE(q.total_quota, 0) AS difference
FROM keys k
LEFT JOIN sales s ON s.sp_id = k.sp_id AND s.yr = k.yr
LEFT JOIN quota q ON q.sp_id = k.sp_id AND q.yr = k.yr
ORDER BY k.sp_id, k.yr

WITH base AS (
  SELECT d.name_id AS director_id,
         n.name AS director_name,
         m.date_published AS dp,
         m.duration AS duration,
         r.avg_rating AS avg_rating,
         r.total_votes AS total_votes
  FROM director_mapping d
  JOIN names n ON n.id = d.name_id
  JOIN movies m ON m.id = d.movie_id
  JOIN ratings r ON r.movie_id = d.movie_id
),
seq AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         dp,
         LAG(dp) OVER (PARTITION BY director_id ORDER BY dp) AS prev_dp
  FROM base
),
gaps AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         AVG(julianday(dp) - julianday(prev_dp)) AS avg_gap
  FROM seq
  WHERE prev_dp IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY director_id
),
agg AS (
  SELECT director_id,
         director_name,
         COUNT(*) AS num_movies,
         ROUND(AVG(avg_rating), 2) AS avg_rating,
         SUM(total_votes) AS total_votes,
         MIN(avg_rating) AS min_rating,
         MAX(avg_rating) AS max_rating,
         SUM(duration) AS total_duration
  FROM base
  GROUP BY director_id, director_name
)
SELECT a.director_id,
       a.director_name,
       a.num_movies,
       ROUND(COALESCE(g.avg_gap, 0)) AS avg_inter_movie_duration,
       a.avg_rating,
       a.total_votes,
       a.min_rating,
       a.max_rating,
       a.total_duration
FROM agg a
LEFT JOIN gaps g ON g.director_id = a.director_id
ORDER BY a.num_movies DESC, a.total_duration DESC
LIMIT 9

WITH RECURSIVE nums(n) AS (
  SELECT 0
  UNION ALL
  SELECT n + 1 FROM nums WHERE n < 19
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT id_bioguide,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', term_start) AS INTEGER) AS start_year
  FROM legislators_terms
  WHERE term_number = 0
    AND term_start BETWEEN '1917-01-01' AND '1999-12-31'
),
coverage AS (
  SELECT c.id_bioguide,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', t.term_start) AS INTEGER) - c.start_year AS n_min,
         CAST(strftime('%Y', COALESCE(t.term_end, '9999-12-31')) AS INTEGER) - c.start_year
           - (CASE WHEN strftime('%m-%d', COALESCE(t.term_end, '9999-12-31')) < '12-31' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS n_max
  FROM cohort c
  JOIN legislators_terms t ON t.id_bioguide = c.id_bioguide
),
retained AS (
  SELECT nums.n AS n,
         COUNT(DISTINCT coverage.id_bioguide) AS retained_count
  FROM nums
  JOIN coverage ON coverage.n_min <= nums.n AND nums.n <= coverage.n_max
  GROUP BY nums.n
)
SELECT nums.n + 1 AS period,
       ROUND(CAST(COALESCE(retained.retained_count, 0) AS REAL) / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cohort), 4) AS retention_rate
FROM nums
LEFT JOIN retained ON retained.n = nums.n
ORDER BY nums.n

  FROM word_list
  WHERE LENGTH(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
chars(word, ch, rest) AS (
  SELECT word, substr(word, 1, 1), substr(word, 2) FROM pool
  UNION ALL
  SELECT word, substr(rest, 1, 1), substr(rest, 2) FROM chars WHERE LENGTH(rest) > 0
),
keys AS (
  SELECT word, group_concat(ch, '') AS k
  FROM (SELECT word, ch FROM chars ORDER BY word, ch)
  GROUP BY word
),
grp AS (
  SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM keys GROUP BY k
)
SELECT a.word AS word, g.cnt - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM keys a
JOIN grp g ON g.k = a.k
WHERE substr(a.word, 1, 1) = 'r'
  AND g.cnt > 1
ORDER BY a.word
LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE base AS (SELECT DISTINCT words AS w FROM word_list), split(w, ch, rest) AS (SELECT w, substr(w,1,1), substr(w,2) FROM base UNION ALL SELECT w, substr(rest,1,1), substr(rest,2) FROM split WHERE rest <> ''), sig AS (SELECT w, group_concat(ch,'') AS s FROM (SELECT w, ch FROM split ORDER BY w, ch) GROUP BY w) SELECT a.w AS word, COUNT(*) AS anagram_count FROM sig a JOIN sig b ON b.s = a.s AND b.w <> a.w WHERE length(a.w) BETWEEN 4 AND 5 AND substr(a.w,1,1) = 'r' GROUP BY a.w ORDER BY a.w LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE base(w) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words FROM word_list WHERE length(words) IN (4,5)
),
chars(w, pos, ch) AS (
  SELECT w, 1, substr(w,1,1) FROM base
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w, pos+1, substr(w,pos+1,1) FROM chars WHERE pos < length(w)
),
keys AS (
  SELECT w, group_concat(ch,'') AS k
  FROM (SELECT w, ch FROM chars ORDER BY w, ch)
  GROUP BY w
),
grp AS (
  SELECT k, COUNT(*) AS n FROM keys GROUP BY k
)
SELECT k.w AS word, g.n - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM keys k
JOIN grp g ON g.k = k.k
WHERE substr(k.w,1,1) = 'r' AND g.n > 1
ORDER BY k.w
LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE cand(w) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words FROM word_list WHERE length(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
split(w, pos, ch) AS (
  SELECT w, 1, substr(w, 1, 1) FROM cand
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w, pos + 1, substr(w, pos + 1, 1) FROM split WHERE pos < length(w)
),
sig AS (
  SELECT w, group_concat(ch, '') AS s
  FROM (SELECT w, ch FROM split ORDER BY w, ch)
  GROUP BY w
),
cnt AS (
  SELECT s, COUNT(*) AS n FROM sig GROUP BY s
)
SELECT sig.w AS word, cnt.n - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM sig JOIN cnt ON cnt.s = sig.s
WHERE length(sig.w) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
  AND substr(sig.w, 1, 1) = 'r'
  AND cnt.n - 1 >= 1
ORDER BY sig.w
LIMIT 10

WITH RECURSIVE wl(words) AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT words FROM word_list WHERE length(words) BETWEEN 4 AND 5
),
bub(w, p, k, s) AS (
  SELECT words, 0, 1, words FROM wl
  UNION ALL
  SELECT w,
         CASE WHEN k >= length(s) THEN p + 1 ELSE p END,
         CASE WHEN k >= length(s) THEN 1 ELSE k + 1 END,
         CASE WHEN k < length(s) AND substr(s, k, 1) > substr(s, k + 1, 1)
              THEN substr(s, 1, k - 1) || substr(s, k + 1, 1) || substr(s, k, 1) || substr(s, k + 2)
              ELSE s END
  FROM bub
  WHERE p < length(s)
),
sig AS (
  SELECT w, s FROM bub WHERE p = length(s)
),
grp AS (
  SELECT s, COUNT(*) AS c FROM sig GROUP BY s
)
SELECT sig.w AS word, grp.c - 1 AS anagram_count
FROM sig JOIN grp ON grp.s = sig.s
WHERE sig.w LIKE 'r%' AND grp.c > 1
ORDER BY sig.w
LIMIT 10

SELECT h.hub_id,
       h.hub_name,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS feb_finished_orders,
       SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS mar_finished_orders,
       ROUND((CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
              / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 1) * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM hubs h
JOIN stores s ON s.hub_id = h.hub_id
JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id
WHERE o.order_status = 'FINISHED'
  AND o.order_created_year = 2021
  AND o.order_created_month IN (2, 3)
GROUP BY h.hub_id, h.hub_name
HAVING SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) > 0
   AND (CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL)
        / SUM(CASE WHEN o.order_created_month = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) - 1) > 0.2
ORDER BY pct_increase DESC

       h.hub_name,
       p.feb_orders,
       p.mar_orders,
       ROUND((CAST(p.mar_orders AS REAL) - p.feb_orders) / p.feb_orders * 100, 2) AS pct_increase
FROM per_hub p
JOIN hubs h ON h.hub_id = p.hub_id
WHERE p.feb_orders > 0
  AND (CAST(p.mar_orders AS REAL) - p.feb_orders) / p.feb_orders > 0.2

WITH s AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         mth,
         qty,
         (CAST(strftime('%Y', mth) AS INTEGER) - 2016) * 12 + CAST(strftime('%m', mth) AS INTEGER) AS midx
  FROM monthly_sales
),
w AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         midx,
         qty,
         AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY midx ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING) AS win1_avg,
         AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY midx ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS win2_avg,
         COUNT(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY midx ROWS BETWEEN 5 PRECEDING AND 6 FOLLOWING) AS win1_cnt,
         COUNT(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY midx ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) AS win2_cnt
  FROM s
),
cma AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         midx,
         qty,
         (win1_avg + win2_avg) / 2.0 AS cma_qty
  FROM w
  WHERE midx BETWEEN 7 AND 30
    AND win1_cnt = 12
    AND win2_cnt = 12
    AND win1_avg + win2_avg > 0
),
ratio AS (
  SELECT product_id,
         midx,
         CAST(qty AS REAL) / cma_qty AS sales_to_cma
  FROM cma
  WHERE midx BETWEEN 13 AND 24
)
SELECT product_id
FROM ratio
GROUP BY product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 AND MIN(sales_to_cma) > 2
ORDER BY product_id

),
w AS (

         + AVG(qty) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY t ROWS BETWEEN 6 PRECEDING AND 5 FOLLOWING) ) / 2.0 AS cma

)

GROUP BY product_id
HAVING COUNT(*) = 12 AND MIN(qty / cma) > 2

SELECT a.path AS page,
       COUNT(DISTINCT a.session) AS total_sessions
FROM activity_log a
JOIN (
    SELECT session,
           MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp,
           MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
    FROM activity_log
    GROUP BY session
) s
  ON a.session = s.session
WHERE a.stamp = s.first_stamp
   OR a.stamp = s.last_stamp
GROUP BY a.path
ORDER BY total_sessions DESC, a.path

WITH sess AS (
  SELECT session, MIN(stamp) AS first_stamp, MAX(stamp) AS last_stamp
  FROM activity_log
  GROUP BY session
),
land AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.session, a.path
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN sess s ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.first_stamp
),
exit_p AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT a.session, a.path
  FROM activity_log a
  JOIN sess s ON a.session = s.session AND a.stamp = s.last_stamp
)
SELECT path, COUNT(DISTINCT session) AS total_unique_sessions
FROM (
  SELECT session, path FROM land
  UNION ALL
  SELECT session, path FROM exit_p
) u
GROUP BY path
ORDER BY total_unique_sessions DESC, path
